code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       if grid[i][j]!=2 or (i,j) in seen: continue
       stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
       while stack:
        a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
        for q in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
         if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen: seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
       comps.append(comp)
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    for comp in comps:
      ys=[a for a,b in comp]; xs=[b for a,b in comp]; y=min(ys); x=min(xs)
      r=min(2, round(sum(ys)/len(ys)*2/max(1,h-1)))
      c=min(5, round(sum(xs)/len(xs)*5/max(1,w-1)))
      cnt={a:ys.count(a) for a in set(ys)}
      val=3 if cnt[min(cnt)]==1 else 1

    return out
